text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Victoria Mile. Verxina's 
focus was razor-sharp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike before, I didn't say anything 
specific to fire her up today. I knew it 
wasn't necessary. That was because—
choice_data_list:
(She clearly sees what she needs to do 
today.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...What could be the matter with everyone, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated, depressed... Either way, she's 
hanging her head down.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As far as pre-race conduct goes, that is 
hardly appropriate, is it?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...! But...! Do you have any idea what the 
crowd is saying!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Predicting today's winner is easy! It's 
gotta be Verxina.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah, I bet. Because—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"—'Only because Gentildonna wasn't there.' 
That's what they're saying...!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"We've each achieved great results to get 
this far too! So why talk like there's no 
main star here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You must hate it too, Verxina-san! Being 
talked about like that—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I recommend switching gears right away.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is the pinnacle of the Tiara route— 
the Victoria Mile, you see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious race where wonderful 
predecessors fought thrilling, fierce 
battles...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver a run capable of rewriting 
that history.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Is there anything else I should be doing?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —That's right, everyone. Let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the Tiara is intense! I 
just have to show them that, right?

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Verxina-san? ...You'll accept a fair 
and square head-to-head match, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Everyone, please follow 
after me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let us show them the true brilliance of 
the Tiara we seek!
